items.claim: CFO gives Q4 revenue guidance range.
items.quote: revenue to be in the range of $1.25 billion to $1.29 billion
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO gives Q4 non-GAAP EPS guidance range.
items.quote: non-GAAP EPS to be in the range of $3.72 to $3.87
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO frames Q4 revenue guidance as ~40% YoY growth at the midpoint.
items.quote: year-over-year growth of approximately 40% at the midpoint
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO reports Q3 non-GAAP gross margin.
items.quote: Gross margin in the third quarter was 12.1%
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO says Q4 FX headwind on margin is expected to be similar to Q3.
items.quote: we anticipate to be at that same level.
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO acknowledges near-term gross margin pressure from new program ramps and FX.
items.quote: while there are some near-term pressures on gross margin
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CEO says the company is ahead of competitors in making CPO technology a reality.
items.quote: well ahead of our competitors in making this technology
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO attributes telecom growth beyond DCI partly to share gains from competitors.
items.quote: mostly share gain maybe from some of our competitors.
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO announces a minority investment in Raytek Semiconductor to support CPO manufacturing efforts.
items.quote: we have made a minority investment in Raytek Semiconductor
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CFO details the size of the private placement funding the Raytek stake.
items.quote: a private placement of approximately $32 million
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO reports remaining share buyback authorization at quarter end.
items.quote: $169 million available under our current authorization
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CFO discloses no meaningful share repurchase activity occurred in Q3.
items.quote: we did not repurchase a meaningful number of shares
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CEO announces completed qualification and start of shipping on two hyperscaler Datacom transceiver programs.
items.quote: qualification and have already begun shipping 2 Datacom
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO says the company is on track to qualify and ramp multiple merchant transceiver programs.
items.quote: We are on track to qualify and ramp multiple merchant
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO notes overlap of common customers with Raytek as part of the rationale for the investment.
items.quote: We already serve a number of common customers
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO characterizes demand from the new hyperscale customer as very significant.
items.quote: that we're seeing from the customer is very significant
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO states Datacom demand is currently outpacing supply of certain components.
items.quote: demand is outpacing the broader supply of certain components
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO expects the Datacom supply/demand imbalance to continue into Q4.
items.quote: supply/demand imbalance to persist into the fourth quarter
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CEO cites a global memory shortage as one of the supply constraints, alongside lasers and certain ASICs.
items.quote: there's a global shortage of memory
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

items.claim: CFO reaffirms commitment to returning surplus cash to shareholders via the buyback program.
items.quote: committed to returning surplus cash to shareholders
items.speaker: Csaba Sverha (CFO)

items.claim: CEO reaffirms the company's service-model commitment to never compete with its own customers.
items.quote: We never compete with our customers.
items.speaker: Seamus Grady (CEO)

qa_flags.question: Are you expecting that these programs stand-alone are like 10% of your revenue? Is it that sizable relative to the opportunity?
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO does not size the new customer programs; redirects to a stated policy of only disclosing 10%-customer status retrospectively at fiscal year-end, never forward-looking, then closes with a vague reference to "a few other significant opportunities."

qa_flags.question: Do you believe you will be at the full run rate of the current HPC program in June? I think the previous expectation was March and June time frame.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO confirms the previously communicated $150 million quarterly HPC run-rate milestone will now be pushed out by about one quarter versus the prior timeline, framed alongside reassurance that the longer-term trajectory is 'stronger.'

qa_flags.question: I just want to ask a little bit more pointedly, if 800ZR in particular, drove an outsized portion of the growth this quarter or if it was more broadly spread.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO declines to quantify 800ZR's specific contribution to DCI/Telecom growth, stating it is 'more appropriate for our customers to talk about that,' offering only qualitative characterization instead.
